description: Raw punch issues for yourself (打刻漏れチェック): missing clock-out/in, break left open, no punches on a workday, days over 12 hours, rest under 11 hours (勤務間インターバル), holiday work. Does NOT check Labor Standards Act break length (6h/45min, 8h/60min), man-hours, or the monthly overtime trajectory — close_out does, in one call. A missing punch is suppressed when the working record already has that time. Defaults: the 1st of this month through yesterday (on the 1st, the previous month), Japan time, YYYY-MM-DD, max 93 days. Today is excluded because the day may still be open. Overnight shifts are recognized. Leave is invisible, so "no punches" may be a day off. Fixing punches is 修正申請 in the web UI, not punch.

to.description: End date, inclusive (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to yesterday.
